play.title: Let your tutees play around!
play.paragraph1: Ayhoot transforms traditional learning into an engaging and interactive experience. Our platform is designed for institutes that want to bring excitement into the classroom. Create dynamic 'Ayhoots' (our term for games and quizzes) that students can play live, fostering a competitive and collaborative spirit. The visual feedback and real-time leaderboards keep everyone hooked from start to finish.
play.paragraph2: For individual tutors and teachers, Ayhoot offers a powerful set of tools to connect with students on a new level. Go beyond static worksheets and create personalized learning journeys. Our platform allows you to monitor individual progress, identify areas where students are struggling, and provide targeted feedback to help them succeed. It’s about making learning a personal and rewarding adventure.
play.seo1: Online classes, online exams by Ayhoot.

items.name: Ali Ghaffari.
items.text: Ayhoot has completely changed my classroom dynamics. My students are more engaged than ever, and their test scores have improved significantly!

items.name: Aygun Academy
items.text: We use Ayhoot for our employee onboarding. The gamification makes mandatory training fun and much more memorable. Highly recommended.

items.name: Nematollahi
items.text: Studying used to be a chore, but playing Ayhoots with my friends to review for exams is something I actually look forward to. It works!
